summary: San Augustine County tower the inventory dates to about 1937 and removes in 1968, with a Moved To note reading 'to Poyner' that the sources do not confirm.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone. No source describes what, if anything, remains on the hill.

events.note: Inventory date column reads c1937, an approximate year.
Moved To column reads 'to Poyner'. The inventory gives no date for the move, so no year is recorded. The Poyner it names is not confirmed as Poyner (Fincastle).

notes_for_editor: Record matches the county list (county, coordinates, gone). The inventory's district code ANF is not defined in the table, so no agency is given. The move to Poyner rests on one inventory cell: the Poyner (Fincastle) row has no 'fr' note naming Hi Point, so the link is unconfirmed. The inventory gives height 100 with no unit, so no height_m is recorded. A different San Augustine tower west of town is not this site and was not used.
